Visualize Colors along with Color Vision Deficiency Simulations

Source: R/visualize_colors_cvd.R
visualize_colors_cvd.Rd

Display a original color palette and the simulated palettes under protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia.

Usage

visualize_colors_cvd(color_palette, cvd_severity = 1, show_names = TRUE)

Arguments

color_palette

A character vector of colors in a format accepted by grDevices::col2rgb().

cvd_severity

Numeric between 0 and 1 defining the severity of the color vision deficiency.

show_names

Logical scalar indicating whether names of a named color_palette should be displayed below the color bars. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

Invisibly returns a named list containing the original colors and their simulated appearance under protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia.

Details

Color vision deficiencies are simulated using the transformations implemented by the colorspace package.

The function produces four horizontal color-bar plots showing the original colors and their appearance under the three simulated color vision deficiencies. If a named color_palette is provided and show_names = TRUE, the color names are displayed below the corresponding color bars

See also

colorspace::protan(), colorspace::deutan(), colorspace::tritan()

Examples

color_palette <- create_color_range(c("#2166AC", "#B2182B"), 6)
visualize_colors_cvd(color_palette)
